text:
sasha: Morning folks — quick proposal: shift our weekly triage from Wed 11:00 → Tue 9:30 for the next 6 weeks while we run the sprint freeze. Also propose a compact agenda: 1) backlog scrub (5m) 2) owner check (5m) 3) hotfix lane (5m) 4) async follow-ups. Who can cover owner check / ring? :raised_hand:

liam: +1 on earlier time. I can take Tue 9:30 the first two weeks. if we switch I’ll update the calendar. quick question — do we still want the pre-read thread?

katie: mornings are rough for me this week — prefer Wed. can we record and keep an async pre-read? otherwise i’m +1 for compacting agenda.

rachel: i'm ok moving it to Tue but would prefer 10:00 if that helps people. also can we add a tiny "PM flag" item for any tickets that need PM attention?

devex-bot: poll created: React with :one: for Tue 9:30, :two: for Tue 10:00, :three: for Wed 11:00. Poll closes tomorrow 12:00 PT.

sasha: thanks — procedural note: owner nominations should be dropped into #eng-triage-owners before EOD Mon. format: `@owner -> component` (example: `@liam -> runtime`). we'll pick owners during the owner check slot.

liam: noted — will nominate @maria for model-serving.

katie: if we land on 9:30 i’ll prep an async pre-read with 3 bullet PRs and a short backlog snapshot. also please timebox to 15m; i can't spill into PM sync.

rachel: +1 to the 15m timebox. also add a 30s regressions quick-check line to the scrub agenda.

sasha: sounds like consensus leaning toward Tue 9:30. @devex-bot please close poll at noon PT tomorrow and update the recurring calendar invite accordingly. thanks all :tada:
